items.reason: Gap 1 describes two deliveries in the handler's async window both passing the set check because the id is added only after the handler finishes.
Gap 0 says the dedup key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body, so a differing header bypasses the check.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the map registers refund.created, so refunds hit the no-handler path.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency raised is within one process's queue.
